summary: Auditoria local limitada ao módulo de bancos: tentativas indevidas negadas no emulador; não é certificação de produção.

checks.createUpdateSchema: strict required keys, bounded strings, integer cents, immutable origin/ownership
checks.authority: personal path owner; group protected claims+authorization+active group, not editable membership
checks.financialConsistency: two-document creation required by getAfter; immutable opening; no balance mutation or delete
checks.concurrency: revision checks and one opening per account operation ID
checks.defaultDeny: unknown collections/subcollections and other financial writes denied
limitations: No server-enforced per-user rate limit on Spark: an authorized user can exhaust shared quotas with repeated legitimate requests.
Different operation IDs can represent different accounts with equal names; bank name is not a unique account identity.
Future movements/corrections require their own atomic model and Rules; this stage permits openings only.

reviewFixes: Post-commit refresh cannot reuse an earlier page
Intent rotation serialized and compared to expected ID across tabs
Form input waits for context and pending result lookup
New personal namespace only readable by its owner
